wiki.title: André Jacque
wiki.extract: André M. Jacque (born October 13, 1980) is an American consultant and Republican politician from De Pere, Wisconsin. He is a member of the Wisconsin Senate, representing Wisconsin's 1st Senate district since 2019. He previously served four terms in the Wisconsin State Assembly (2011–2019). He was a candidate in the 2024 Republican primary for United States House of Representatives in Wisconsin's 8th congressional district.
